activity.role: Warrior; later remembered as a war chief
activity.notes: Pretty Nose is a documented Arapaho woman photographed in the late 1870s and remembered in Arapaho family tradition as a war chief who participated in the Battle of the Little Bighorn. Because the evidence for a formal tribe-wide chieftainship is retrospective, ATLAS records the defensible 1876 warrior activity rather than treating her as the sovereign ruler of all Arapaho.
